description: This file defines a set of functions for handling JSON serialization and deserialization within a CMake build system. It provides callbacks for JSON objects, arrays, literals, and key-value pairs, enabling the construction and parsing of JSON data structures within CMake scripts.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function that initializes JSON processing, sets up callback handlers, and executes the parsing or building of JSON data based on provided arguments.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to append a '{' when beginning a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to append a '}' when ending a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to append a '[' when beginning a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to append a ']' when ending a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to process the key of a JSON object property and append it properly formatted.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to insert a comma if more key-value pairs follow in the current JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to insert a comma if more elements follow in the current JSON array.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals such as null, true, false, or string/number values.
